US holiday retail sales are forecast to rise 4.5% and cross $1 trillion this season, Bain finds, while a McKinsey survey shows 43% of shoppers planning to spend less on jewelry this year and just 18% planning to spend more. Gen Z names jewelry a top category far more than older generations, 18% against 5% for Baby Boomers. More than half of Bain's growth is inflation, not extra goods sold. Palladium was the only precious metal to rise this morning, up 0.58% to $1,377 an ounce, while gold, silver and platinum all slipped. Gold fell $25.10 to $4,403.90, silver dropped 0.75% to $65.60, and platinum eased 0.06% to $1,815.00, all read at Kitco's 06:04 ET press-time tick on a trading Labor Day.
